who: GPT-6 Astra Pro, distributed transport review lane
what: Production acceptance run 46032696808 executed and passed a-test-sees-the-library-beside-its-bin, then failed removing its temporary HOME alias container with ENOTEMPTY. The run stopped after 17 of 23 fixtures passed, leaving the final five unexecuted.
cost: A successful compiler test could not supply migration acceptance because the harness began namespace cleanup without proving every process using that namespace had exited.
cause: run_command waited for its foreground PID only. Blaze may launch detached background GC with the same HOME; setsid moves that helper outside the process group used for timeout cleanup. The failure artifact has no leftover-directory listing, so it does not identify the specific remaining writer.
whys: cleanup_logical_home unlinked the short HOME alias before removing its parent directory.
Foreground exit was treated as proof that no descendant could still use or recreate the alias.
The timeout helper signalled a process group, which does not contain descendants that create their own sessions.
No causal fixture had held a detached HOME user beyond foreground completion.
class: temporary namespace cleanup precedes completion of the process tree that owns it
prevention: On Linux, each serial command enters subreaper ownership after a non-reaping probe refuses pre-existing children. Detached descendants are reaped before HOME cleanup. Draining has an explicit deadline; forced cleanup verifies every PID remains an unreaped child before signalling it. Incomplete cleanup retains both subreaper ownership and the HOME aliases, records the failure, and stops acceptance. A missing or unreadable completion record after an exception also retains aliases without replacing the original failure. The existing non-Linux process-group path remains supported.
fix: Added recorded descendant outcomes and completion evidence, deterministic ownership and timeout controls, and a Linux fork/setsid fixture whose pipe handshake holds the helper past foreground exit. A planted foreground-only completion rule fails the same oracle. Cleanup errors, fixture coverage, and provenance requirements remain mandatory.
state: Implemented with local causal tests; the main lane coordinates hosted migration acceptance.
